name: Longhorn Publishers Limited
source: Longhorn Publishers Plc audited financial results for the year ended 30 June 2025, issuer press release dated 23 October 2025; figures absolute KES | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 3 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move. | CRON 20261014: H1 2026 column added from Longhorn Publishers Plc unaudited condensed group results for the six month period ended 31 December 2025, the first half of the financial year ending 30 June 2026 (Kshs thousands read as absolute KES): revenue and other income 524,178; cost of sales 284,431; gross profit 239,747; operating expenses 167,872; finance costs 82,870; loss before tax 10,995; income tax nil as printed; loss after tax 10,995; basic and diluted loss per share 0.04. All ties hold on the printed lines: revenue less cost of sales equals the printed gross profit 239,747; gross profit less operating expenses equals 71,875; that less net finance costs equals the printed loss before tax 10,995, and the same construction reproduces the stored FY2025 Profit Before Tax of 373,149 from its own gross profit, operating expenses and net finance costs exactly. Operating Profit (EBIT) is derived as gross profit less operating expenses and is tagged by that formula. The period label follows this dataset convention of naming the half year by the financial year it belongs to.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.withheld: 122x is beyond the 100x ceiling; equity is near zero on audited figures
rows.derivedCellFormula: Debt to Equity = Total Liabilities / Total Equity

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT), and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Profit (EBIT) = Gross Profit - Operating Expenses
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Operating Profit (EBIT) - Net Finance Costs = Profit Before Tax; the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

rows.label: EPS
rows.formula: Net Profit / weighted average shares implied by the company's own reported EPS

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.withheld: equity of 18.1m against a 261.4m loss gives -1444%, beyond the 200% ceiling; inputs are audited
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROE (%) = Net Profit / Total Equity x 100
